info.title: Sim API v2 — Workspace Resources
info.description: Version 2 of the Sim REST API for workspace metadata, members, MCP servers, skills, custom tools, credentials, and write-only secrets.

tags.name: Workspaces
tags.description: Read workspace metadata and its effective member roster.

tags.name: MCP Servers
tags.description: Register and manage Model Context Protocol servers.

tags.name: Skills
tags.description: Create and manage reusable instruction documents for agents.

tags.name: Custom Tools
tags.description: Create and manage code-backed tools that agents can call.

tags.name: Credentials
tags.description: List OAuth and service-account connections without secret material.

tags.name: Secrets
tags.description: Set and manage write-only workspace and personal secret values.

get.description: Return public metadata for one accessible workspace. Governance identities, billing identities, and internal membership identifiers are intentionally omitted.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace to retrieve.

schema.description: Workspace to retrieve.

get.description: List the workspace's effective members ordered by email. Explicit workspace grants and inherited organization-administrator grants are merged; internal membership and billing identities are omitted.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace to retrieve.

schema.description: Workspace to retrieve.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum members to return. Defaults to 50 and cannot exceed 100.

schema.description: Maximum members to return. Defaults to 50 and cannot exceed 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the preceding page.

schema.description: Opaque cursor returned by the preceding page.

200.description: An email-ordered page of effective workspace members.

get.description: List MCP servers registered in a workspace. Request-header values and OAuth client secrets are never returned. The bounded workspace set uses the standard cursor envelope with `nextCursor` set to null.

200.description: MCP servers registered in the workspace.

post.description: Register an MCP server in a workspace. The endpoint URL determines server identity, must be absolute HTTP or HTTPS, and cannot contain environment-variable references. Header values and OAuth client secrets are write-only.

requestBody.description: Configuration for a new MCP server.

patch.description: Update the supplied MCP server fields. The URL is immutable because it determines server identity; delete and recreate the server to change endpoints. Authentication changes invalidate the existing OAuth grant.

schema.description: MCP server to retrieve, update, or delete.
